# Suncly

> Suncly is an evaluation tool for AI agents that speak the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It reads an agent's Agent Card, tests every declared skill repeatedly in a sandbox, judges each run deterministically, signs the evidence, and gives platform and security teams a report that states what passed, what failed, what stayed inconclusive and what was never tested, so they can approve the agent on evidence instead of a spreadsheet.

Suncly is a command-line tool in pilot, made in Tallinn, Estonia. It is model-agnostic: any agent that publishes an A2A 1.0 Agent Card and answers over JSON-RPC can be evaluated, whatever model or framework built it. In the current version every automatic decision is "flag", so a human reviews every result; approve and block are never produced automatically. Suncly never calls a model provider, never tests a production endpoint, and holds the agent credential only inside an isolated Runner process. Nothing on suncly.com states customers, prices, benchmarks or guarantees. Contact: team@suncly.com.

## Product

- [Product](https://suncly.com/product): what Suncly does today (available), with limits (available with limits), and what is planned, each entry naming the code and test behind it.
- [Supported workflows and integrations](https://suncly.com/workflows): A2A 1.0 over JSON-RPC coverage, model-agnosticism, frameworks, integrations, and the eleven bundled sandbox agents.
- [Sample evaluation](https://suncly.com/demo): three signed evaluations of a fictional agent produced by the real code path: a baseline, a regression behind an unchanged card, and a budget-stopped failure.
- [Security and data handling](https://suncly.com/security): what Suncly accesses, where credentials are handled, what reaches external providers (nothing), what evidence is stored, retention, deployment, sandbox requirements, limitations.
- [Glossary](https://suncly.com/glossary): A2A protocol, Agent Card, attestation, contract, test case, run, verdict, inconclusive, decision, probe, sandbox declaration, card_hash, signed evidence, what was NOT tested.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://suncly.com/docs/getting-started): install, run `suncly demo`, evaluate a sandbox agent with `suncly attest <card-url> --sandbox`, read and verify the report.
- [Command reference](https://suncly.com/docs/cli): every command, option, exit code, environment variable and the contract file format.
- [Evidence and reports](https://suncly.com/docs/evidence): the report folder (result.json, transcripts, report.md, report.html), what the Ed25519 signature covers, `suncly verify`.

## Company

- [Company](https://suncly.com/company): principles and contact.
- [Access](https://suncly.com/access): pilot access by email; no self-serve sign-up, no published price, no checkout.
